extraction_notes: Avalanche and unclamped inductive switching (UIS/EAS) are not modelled.
Safe operating area is not enforced.
No self-heating in the default three-terminal instance.
Package and lead inductance are not modelled.
Gate oxide breakdown beyond the rated maximum is not modelled.
P-channel voltages and currents are recorded as magnitudes for fitting; source signs are negative.
RDS(on) maximums are 13 mOhm at 10 V/20 A and 22 mOhm at 4.5 V/10 A; typical values are recorded.
Qg = 42 nC, Qgs = 7.3 nC, Qgd = 8.5 nC at abs(VDS) = 20 V, abs(ID) = 20 A, abs(VGS) = 10 V.
Diode forward current maximum is 40 A; reverse recovery is not published.
RthetaJC = 6.3 degC/W max is published; no junction-to-ambient value is published.
